item.title: One Student One Chip: From ISA to RTL
item.description: Building an instruction-set simulator and a single-cycle processor to connect software execution with hardware implementation.
item.content:encoded:
Overview

March 2026 - Present · Independent project

Student ID: ysyx_26040133 · Entrance defense passed

Software: NEMU

Implemented an RV32I instruction-set simulator in C, including clock, keyboard, and VGA device emulation. Added expression evaluation, watchpoints, and support for running CPU-test programs.

Hardware: A single-cycle processor

Implemented a single-cycle minirv processor in Verilog, covering instruction fetch, decode, execution, memory access, and write-back. Verified functionality with CPU-test and Spike differential testing, and used Logisim to check the datapath and control logic.

Tools & learning log

Git, Make, GCC, GDB, Verilog, and Spike.

item.title: Research & Practice: From Simulation to Control
item.description: Research in RISC-V simulation, hands-on hardware integration, and development of a rocket ignition control system.
item.content:encoded:
National EDA Innovation Center

February 2026 - Present · Research Intern

Reproduced Decoupled Vector Runahead on gem5 RISC-V O3CPU. Used workloads and traces to verify features and debug dependence-chain detection. Ran HPC and GAP benchmarks and regression tests, and analyzed cache miss rates, prefetch accuracy, and IPC.

Shenzhen Matrix Epoch Technology

January - April 2026 · Hardware & Supply Chain Research

Contributed to technical validation of smart bands, millimeter-wave radar, and other devices. Built a PyQt6 desktop application for data collection and debugging, and assisted with a data collection app and a hardware-to-cloud SaaS platform.

Beijing Mianchao Aerospace Technology

April - September 2025 · Embedded Systems Intern

Contributed to a reusable rocket igniter control system, developing timing logic and control programs for ignition triggering, state monitoring, and emergency interruption. Participated in multiple ignition trials.

Independently developed a desktop control application for parameter configuration, real-time monitoring, and historical data review. Designed an attitude-control concept using a nine-axis sensor and servos.

item.title: FPGA × SoC: Real-Time Vision Pipeline
item.description: A configurable ISP and Gigabit Ethernet video pipeline, with measured throughput of 720 Mbps and processing-to-transmission latency of 200 ms.
item.content:encoded:
Overview

May - September 2025 · Hardware Lead

Built an FPGA+SoC heterogeneous system around the Anlogic PH1A. The FPGA handled image acquisition, real-time ISP, PWM control, and networking; the SoC ran the operating system, scheduled peripherals, and performed edge AI inference.

Configurable image processing

Implemented a Verilog ISP pipeline with black-level correction, demosaicing, automatic white balance, Gamma correction, filtering, and sharpening. Supported runtime algorithm switching and parameter adjustment.

Networking & system integration

Implemented GMII/RGMII interfaces, the MAC layer, and a lightweight UDP/IP stack. Measured 720 Mbps wired throughput and 200 ms video processing-to-transmission latency, with redundant Wi-Fi video transmission.

Multi-platform inference & control

Deployed LeNet on the FPGA, MobileNet on the SoC, and YOLOv8 on a PC. Developed a visual desktop application for monitoring, ISP configuration, parameter tuning, and remote control.

item.title: An Inspection Robot for Pomelo Orchards
item.description: Bringing sensing and actuation together with STM32 motion control, LoRa communication, and lightweight computer vision.
item.content:encoded:
Overview

May 2024 - May 2025 · Team Lead

Coordinated project development and team collaboration, contributed to mechanical design, and integrated hardware and software for orchard inspection and targeted spraying.

Control & communication

Developed an STM32-based vehicle control system for basic motion and precision spraying. Independently integrated and debugged LoRa communication, addressed signal interference, and enabled stable data exchange with the host application.

Computer vision

Contributed to YOLOv8 pest and disease model training and lightweight deployment for monitoring young pomelo trees, and participated in designing the interactive web interface.

Outcome

Selected for a university student innovation training project and completed ahead of schedule with an excellent rating.
